title: FOUR GUNS MAX, THE WEAKEST SWAPS OUT
why: His order of 2026-10-13: lets redo the bar at the bottom, so the player can only carry 4 guns max. Build 1 of 8, on the layout as it is. When keys 1 to 4 all hold a real gun and a fifth arrives, the belt used to say GUN SLOTS FULL and leave the new gun in the backpack. It now follows his decision: swap with the lowest gun that is not actively being used, and move the lowest gun to the backpack. The new gun takes the place of the weakest gun that is not in his hands (the stowed gun, or a backpack gun on key 3 or 4) and that gun goes to the backpack with no key, shown in the grid. A found gun weaker than all of them, or tied, goes straight to the backpack and nothing moves. The rank is the tier (the forge MK counted) and then the sustained damage the stat card shows; between guns that tie, the higher key goes. The gun in his hands is never chosen. An issued loaner is left behind, as equipping from the backpack already does. The pickup rows say SLOT n for the new gun and BACKPACK for the one pushed out, and a backpack over its cap drops that gun at his feet with a red BACKPACK FULL row naming it. The bot is untouched.
now: A fifth gun now swaps with your weakest gun that is not in your hands, and that gun goes to the backpack.
